name: Alimak Group AB (publ)
summary: Alimak Group AB (publ) designs, manufactures, sells, and services vertical access and working at height solutions worldwide. It operates through five segments: Facade Access, Construction, Height Safety & Productivity Solutions, Industrial and Wind. The company develops, manufactures, sells, services, and rents construction hoists, transport platforms, and mast climbing work platforms for temporary use in construction and renovation projects; sells used construction products; and provides assembly, disassembly, maintenance, operating assistance, transportation, and insurance services.
